_meta.about: Calibration targets. Each threat gets one damage multiplier, found by bisection so the reference setup hits the target. Ask before changing these (HANDOFF.md).

duel.note: Standard crit Kalista (Yun Tal, IE, LDR, Stormrazor, BotRK) narrowly wins: +5% HP left on average over the five spikes.

lane.note: Doran's Blade + Press the Attack / Alacrity / Cut Down trades exactly even across levels 2, 3 and 6.
